VBA Code for Manual Addition to Test Workbook
================================================

Due to macOS limitations with xlwings (AppleScript doesn't expose VBProject),
VBA modules must be added manually. Follow these steps:

1. Open comprehensive_test.xlsb in Excel
2. Press Option+F11 (or Tools > Macro > Visual Basic Editor) to open VBA Editor
3. Add the following modules:

================================================================================
MODULE 1: Module1 - Basic Functions and Procedures
================================================================================

Sub HelloWorld()
    MsgBox "Hello from VBA!"
End Sub

Function AddNumbers(a As Double, b As Double) As Double
    AddNumbers = a + b
End Function

Function MultiplyNumbers(a As Double, b As Double) As Double
    MultiplyNumbers = a * b
End Function

Function DivideNumbers(a As Double, b As Double) As Double
    If b <> 0 Then
        DivideNumbers = a / b
    Else
        DivideNumbers = 0
        MsgBox "Division by zero error!"
    End If
End Function

Sub ProcessData()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim total As Double
    total = Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(ws.Range("B2:B6"))
    MsgBox "Total: " & total
End Sub

Sub ClearDataSheet()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    ws.Range("B2:B100").ClearContents
End Sub

Function GetMaxValue(rng As Range) As Double
    GetMaxValue = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(rng)
End Function

Function GetMinValue(rng As Range) As Double
    GetMinValue = Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(rng)
End Function

================================================================================
MODULE 2: Module2 - Financial and Business Functions
================================================================================

Function CalculateTax(amount As Double, rate As Double) As Double
    CalculateTax = amount * rate
End Function

Function CalculateDiscount(price As Double, discountPercent As Double) As Double
    CalculateDiscount = price * (1 - discountPercent / 100)
End Function

Function CalculateCompoundInterest(principal As Double, rate As Double, years As Integer) As Double
    CalculateCompoundInterest = principal * (1 + rate) ^ years
End Function

Function CalculateMonthlyPayment(principal As Double, annualRate As Double, years As Integer) As Double
    Dim monthlyRate As Double
    Dim numPayments As Integer
    monthlyRate = annualRate / 12
    numPayments = years * 12
    CalculateMonthlyPayment = principal * (monthlyRate * (1 + monthlyRate) ^ numPayments) / ((1 + monthlyRate) ^ numPayments - 1)
End Function

Sub FormatSheet()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    ws.Range("A1:B1").Font.Bold = True
    ws.Range("A1:B1").Interior.Color = RGB(200, 200, 200)
End Sub

Function GetSheetTotal(sheetName As String, rangeAddr As String) As Double
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sheetName)
    GetSheetTotal = Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(ws.Range(rangeAddr))
End Function

Function CalculateROI(initialInvestment As Double, finalValue As Double) As Double
    CalculateROI = ((finalValue - initialInvestment) / initialInvestment) * 100
End Function

Sub GenerateReport()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim report As String
    report = "Data Report" & vbCrLf
    report = report & "Total Items: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Count(ws.Range("B2:B6")) & vbCrLf
    report = report & "Sum: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(ws.Range("B2:B6")) & vbCrLf
    report = report & "Average: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(ws.Range("B2:B6"))
    MsgBox report
End Sub

================================================================================
MODULE 3: Module3 - String Manipulation Functions
================================================================================

Function ReverseString(inputStr As String) As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    For i = Len(inputStr) To 1 Step -1
        result = result & Mid(inputStr, i, 1)
    Next i
    ReverseString = result
End Function

Function CountWords(inputStr As String) As Integer
    Dim words() As String
    words = Split(Trim(inputStr), " ")
    CountWords = UBound(words) + 1
End Function

Function RemoveSpaces(inputStr As String) As String
    RemoveSpaces = Replace(inputStr, " ", "")
End Function

Function CapitalizeFirst(inputStr As String) As String
    If Len(inputStr) > 0 Then
        CapitalizeFirst = UCase(Left(inputStr, 1)) & LCase(Mid(inputStr, 2))
    Else
        CapitalizeFirst = ""
    End If
End Function

Function ExtractNumbers(inputStr As String) As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim result As String
    result = ""
    For i = 1 To Len(inputStr)
        If IsNumeric(Mid(inputStr, i, 1)) Then
            result = result & Mid(inputStr, i, 1)
        End If
    Next i
    ExtractNumbers = result
End Function

Function PadString(inputStr As String, length As Integer, padChar As String) As String
    Dim result As String
    result = inputStr
    While Len(result) < length
        result = padChar & result
    Wend
    PadString = result
End Function

Function FindSubstring(mainStr As String, subStr As String) As Integer
    FindSubstring = InStr(1, mainStr, subStr)
End Function

================================================================================
MODULE 4: Module4 - Date and Time Functions
================================================================================

Function GetDaysBetween(date1 As Date, date2 As Date) As Integer
    GetDaysBetween = Abs(date2 - date1)
End Function

Function GetAge(birthDate As Date) As Integer
    GetAge = Year(Date) - Year(birthDate)
    If DateSerial(Year(Date), Month(birthDate), Day(birthDate)) > Date Then
        GetAge = GetAge - 1
    End If
End Function

Function IsWeekend(checkDate As Date) As Boolean
    Dim dayOfWeek As Integer
    dayOfWeek = Weekday(checkDate)
    IsWeekend = (dayOfWeek = vbSaturday Or dayOfWeek = vbSunday)
End Function

Function GetBusinessDays(startDate As Date, endDate As Date) As Integer
    Dim currentDate As Date
    Dim count As Integer
    count = 0
    currentDate = startDate
    While currentDate <= endDate
        If Not IsWeekend(currentDate) Then
            count = count + 1
        End If
        currentDate = currentDate + 1
    Wend
    GetBusinessDays = count
End Function

Function FormatDateLong(inputDate As Date) As String
    FormatDateLong = Format(inputDate, "dddd, mmmm dd, yyyy")
End Function

Function GetQuarter(inputDate As Date) As Integer
    GetQuarter = Int((Month(inputDate) - 1) / 3) + 1
End Function

Function AddBusinessDays(startDate As Date, daysToAdd As Integer) As Date
    Dim currentDate As Date
    Dim daysAdded As Integer
    currentDate = startDate
    daysAdded = 0
    While daysAdded < daysToAdd
        currentDate = currentDate + 1
        If Not IsWeekend(currentDate) Then
            daysAdded = daysAdded + 1
        End If
    Wend
    AddBusinessDays = currentDate
End Function

================================================================================
MODULE 5: Module5 - Array and Collection Operations
================================================================================

Sub ProcessArray()
    Dim arr(1 To 10) As Integer
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To 10
        arr(i) = i * 2
    Next i

    Dim sum As Integer
    sum = 0
    For i = 1 To 10
        sum = sum + arr(i)
    Next i

    MsgBox "Sum of array: " & sum
End Sub

Function FindMaxInArray(arr() As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim maxVal As Double
    maxVal = arr(LBound(arr))
    For i = LBound(arr) + 1 To UBound(arr)
        If arr(i) > maxVal Then
            maxVal = arr(i)
        End If
    Next i
    FindMaxInArray = maxVal
End Function

Function FindMinInArray(arr() As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim minVal As Double
    minVal = arr(LBound(arr))
    For i = LBound(arr) + 1 To UBound(arr)
        If arr(i) < minVal Then
            minVal = arr(i)
        End If
    Next i
    FindMinInArray = minVal
End Function

Sub SortArray(arr() As Double)
    Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
    Dim temp As Double
    For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr) - 1
        For j = i + 1 To UBound(arr)
            If arr(i) > arr(j) Then
                temp = arr(i)
                arr(i) = arr(j)
                arr(j) = temp
            End If
        Next j
    Next i
End Sub

Function ArraySum(arr() As Double) As Double
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim sum As Double
    sum = 0
    For i = LBound(arr) To UBound(arr)
        sum = sum + arr(i)
    Next i
    ArraySum = sum
End Function

Function ArrayAverage(arr() As Double) As Double
    ArrayAverage = ArraySum(arr) / (UBound(arr) - LBound(arr) + 1)
End Function

================================================================================
MODULE 6: Module6 - Range and Cell Operations
================================================================================

Sub FormatAllSheets()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ws.Range("A1:Z1").Font.Bold = True
        ws.Range("A1:Z1").Interior.Color = RGB(200, 200, 200)
    Next ws
End Sub

Sub HighlightHighValues()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim cell As Range
    For Each cell In ws.Range("B2:B6")
        If cell.Value > 30 Then
            cell.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 200, 200)
        End If
    Next cell
End Sub

Function GetCellValue(sheetName As String, cellAddr As String) As Variant
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sheetName)
    GetCellValue = ws.Range(cellAddr).Value
End Function

Sub SetCellValue(sheetName As String, cellAddr As String, value As Variant)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sheetName)
    ws.Range(cellAddr).Value = value
End Sub

Sub CopyRange(sourceSheet As String, sourceRange As String, destSheet As String, destRange As String)
    Dim srcWs As Worksheet, destWs As Worksheet
    Set srcWs = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sourceSheet)
    Set destWs = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(destSheet)
    srcWs.Range(sourceRange).Copy destWs.Range(destRange)
End Sub

Sub ClearFormats()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    ws.Range("A1:Z100").ClearFormats
End Sub

Function CountNonEmptyCells(rng As Range) As Integer
    CountNonEmptyCells = Application.WorksheetFunction.CountA(rng)
End Function

Sub AutoFitColumns()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ws.Columns.AutoFit
    Next ws
End Sub

================================================================================
MODULE 7: Module7 - Error Handling and Validation
================================================================================

Function SafeDivide(numerator As Double, denominator As Double) As Variant
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    SafeDivide = numerator / denominator
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    SafeDivide = "Error: Division by zero"
End Function

Function ValidateEmail(email As String) As Boolean
    If InStr(email, "@") > 0 And InStr(email, ".") > 0 Then
        ValidateEmail = True
    Else
        ValidateEmail = False
    End If
End Function

Function IsNumericString(inputStr As String) As Boolean
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Dim testVal As Double
    testVal = CDbl(inputStr)
    IsNumericString = True
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    IsNumericString = False
End Function

Sub ProcessWithErrorHandling()
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim total As Double
    total = Application.WorksheetFunction.Sum(ws.Range("B2:B6"))
    MsgBox "Total: " & total
    Exit Sub

ErrorHandler:
    MsgBox "Error occurred: " & Err.Description
End Sub

Function GetRangeValueSafe(ws As Worksheet, cellAddr As String) As Variant
    On Error GoTo ErrorHandler
    GetRangeValueSafe = ws.Range(cellAddr).Value
    Exit Function

ErrorHandler:
    GetRangeValueSafe = "Error"
End Function

================================================================================
MODULE 8: Module8 - File and Directory Operations
================================================================================

Sub ListAllSheets()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim sheetList As String
    sheetList = "Sheets in workbook:" & vbCrLf
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        sheetList = sheetList & ws.Name & vbCrLf
    Next ws
    MsgBox sheetList
End Sub

Sub CreateBackup()
    Dim backupPath As String
    Dim originalPath As String
    originalPath = ThisWorkbook.FullName
    backupPath = Left(originalPath, InStrRev(originalPath, ".") - 1) & "_backup.xlsb"
    ThisWorkbook.SaveCopyAs backupPath
    MsgBox "Backup created: " & backupPath
End Sub

Function SheetExists(sheetName As String) As Boolean
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sheetName)
    SheetExists = Not ws Is Nothing
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Sub ExportSheetToCSV(sheetName As String, filePath As String)
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets(sheetName)
    ws.Copy
    ActiveWorkbook.SaveAs filePath, xlCSV
    ActiveWorkbook.Close False
End Sub

Sub ProtectAllSheets()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ws.Protect Password:="test123"
    Next ws
    MsgBox "All sheets protected"
End Sub

Sub UnprotectAllSheets()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ws.Unprotect Password:="test123"
    Next ws
    MsgBox "All sheets unprotected"
End Sub

================================================================================
MODULE 9: Module9 - Advanced Calculations
================================================================================

Function CalculateStandardDeviation(rng As Range) As Double
    CalculateStandardDeviation = Application.WorksheetFunction.StDev(rng)
End Function

Function CalculateVariance(rng As Range) As Double
    CalculateVariance = Application.WorksheetFunction.Var(rng)
End Function

Function CalculateMedian(rng As Range) As Double
    CalculateMedian = Application.WorksheetFunction.Median(rng)
End Function

Function CalculateMode(rng As Range) As Double
    On Error Resume Next
    CalculateMode = Application.WorksheetFunction.Mode(rng)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Function CalculatePercentile(rng As Range, percentile As Double) As Double
    CalculatePercentile = Application.WorksheetFunction.Percentile(rng, percentile)
End Function

Function CalculateCorrelation(range1 As Range, range2 As Range) As Double
    CalculateCorrelation = Application.WorksheetFunction.Correl(range1, range2)
End Function

Function CalculateLinearRegression(xRange As Range, yRange As Range) As String
    Dim slope As Double, intercept As Double
    slope = Application.WorksheetFunction.Slope(yRange, xRange)
    intercept = Application.WorksheetFunction.Intercept(yRange, xRange)
    CalculateLinearRegression = "y = " & Format(slope, "0.00") & "x + " & Format(intercept, "0.00")
End Function

Sub PerformStatisticalAnalysis()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim rng As Range
    Set rng = ws.Range("B2:B6")

    Dim stats As String
    stats = "Statistical Analysis" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    stats = stats & "Mean: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Average(rng) & vbCrLf
    stats = stats & "Median: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Median(rng) & vbCrLf
    stats = stats & "Std Dev: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.StDev(rng) & vbCrLf
    stats = stats & "Min: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Min(rng) & vbCrLf
    stats = stats & "Max: " & Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(rng)

    MsgBox stats
End Sub

================================================================================
MODULE 10: Module10 - Utility Functions
================================================================================

Sub ShowWorkbookInfo()
    Dim info As String
    info = "Workbook Information" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf
    info = info & "Name: " & ThisWorkbook.Name & vbCrLf
    info = info & "Path: " & ThisWorkbook.Path & vbCrLf
    info = info & "Full Name: " & ThisWorkbook.FullName & vbCrLf
    info = info & "Sheets: " & ThisWorkbook.Worksheets.Count & vbCrLf
    info = info & "Saved: " & ThisWorkbook.Saved
    MsgBox info
End Sub

Function GetRandomNumber(min As Double, max As Double) As Double
    Randomize
    GetRandomNumber = (max - min) * Rnd + min
End Function

Sub GenerateRandomData()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 2 To 6
        ws.Cells(i, 2).Value = GetRandomNumber(10, 100)
    Next i
End Sub

Sub ClearAllData()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        ws.Cells.ClearContents
    Next ws
    MsgBox "All data cleared"
End Sub

Function IsEven(number As Integer) As Boolean
    IsEven = (number Mod 2 = 0)
End Function

Function IsOdd(number As Integer) As Boolean
    IsOdd = (number Mod 2 = 1)
End Function

Sub PrintAllFormulas()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Dim cell As Range
    Dim formulaList As String
    formulaList = "Formulas in workbook:" & vbCrLf & vbCrLf

    For Each ws In ThisWorkbook.Worksheets
        formulaList = formulaList & "Sheet: " & ws.Name & vbCrLf
        For Each cell In ws.UsedRange
            If cell.HasFormula Then
                formulaList = formulaList & cell.Address & ": " & cell.Formula & vbCrLf
            End If
        Next cell
        formulaList = formulaList & vbCrLf
    Next ws

    Debug.Print formulaList
End Sub

Sub ConvertToUpperCase()
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    Set ws = ThisWorkbook.Sheets("Data")
    Dim cell As Range
    For Each cell In ws.Range("A2:A6")
        If IsNumeric(cell.Value) = False Then
            cell.Value = UCase(cell.Value)
        End If
    Next cell
End Sub

================================================================================
DATA SHEET CODE (Right-click Data sheet > View Code)
================================================================================

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    ' This is sheet-specific code for Data sheet
    If Not Intersect(Target, Range("B2:B6")) Is Nothing Then
        Application.EnableEvents = False
        ' Recalculate formulas
        Application.Calculate
        Application.EnableEvents = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_SelectionChange(ByVal Target As Range)
    ' Another worksheet event
    If Target.Column = 2 Then
        Target.Interior.Color = RGB(255, 255, 200)
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_BeforeDoubleClick(ByVal Target As Range, Cancel As Boolean)
    If Target.Column = 2 Then
        MsgBox "Cell value: " & Target.Value
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_Activate()
    Range("A1").Select
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_Deactivate()
    ' Clean up when leaving sheet
End Sub

================================================================================
CALCULATIONS SHEET CODE (Right-click Calculations sheet > View Code)
================================================================================

Private Sub Worksheet_Activate()
    ' Code that runs when Calculations sheet is activated
    Range("A1").Select
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    ' Recalculate when data changes
    Application.Calculate
    If Target.Value > 100 Then
        Target.Font.Bold = True
        Target.Font.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_BeforeRightClick(ByVal Target As Range, Cancel As Boolean)
    If Target.HasFormula Then
        MsgBox "Formula: " & Target.Formula
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub

================================================================================
COMPLEX SHEET CODE (Right-click Complex sheet > View Code)
================================================================================

Private Sub Worksheet_Calculate()
    ' Runs when sheet recalculates
    Dim lastRow As Integer
    lastRow = Range("A" & Rows.Count).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow > 10 Then
        Range("A1").Interior.Color = RGB(200, 255, 200)
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_FollowHyperlink(ByVal Target As Hyperlink)
    MsgBox "Hyperlink clicked: " & Target.Address
End Sub

================================================================================
CHARTDATA SHEET CODE (Right-click ChartData sheet > View Code)
================================================================================

Private Sub Worksheet_Change(ByVal Target As Range)
    If Not Intersect(Target, Range("B2:C7")) Is Nothing Then
        ' Update chart when data changes
        Application.Calculate
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Worksheet_SelectionChange(ByVal Target As Range)
    If Target.Row >= 2 And Target.Row <= 7 Then
        Target.Interior.Color = RGB(240, 240, 240)
    End If
End Sub

================================================================================
THISWORKBOOK CODE (Double-click ThisWorkbook in Project Explorer)
================================================================================

Private Sub Workbook_Open()
    ' This runs when workbook opens
    MsgBox "Workbook opened! Welcome to the comprehensive test workbook."
    Application.StatusBar = "Workbook loaded successfully"
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_BeforeClose(Cancel As Boolean)
    ' This runs before workbook closes
    Dim response As VbMsgBoxResult
    response = MsgBox("Do you want to save changes?", vbYesNoCancel + vbQuestion)
    If response = vbCancel Then
        Cancel = True
    ElseIf response = vbYes Then
        ThisWorkbook.Save
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    ' This runs when any sheet is changed
    Application.StatusBar = "Sheet " & Sh.Name & " changed at " & Target.Address
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetActivate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    ' This runs when any sheet is activated
    Application.StatusBar = "Active sheet: " & Sh.Name
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetDeactivate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    ' This runs when a sheet is deactivated
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetBeforeDoubleClick(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range, Cancel As Boolean)
    ' This runs when any sheet is double-clicked
    If Target.HasFormula Then
        MsgBox "Formula in " & Sh.Name & "!" & Target.Address & ": " & Target.Formula
        Cancel = True
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetBeforeRightClick(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range, Cancel As Boolean)
    ' This runs when right-clicking on any sheet
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetCalculate(ByVal Sh As Object)
    ' This runs when any sheet recalculates
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetSelectionChange(ByVal Sh As Object, ByVal Target As Range)
    ' This runs when selection changes on any sheet
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_NewSheet(ByVal Sh As Object)
    ' This runs when a new sheet is added
    MsgBox "New sheet created: " & Sh.Name
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_SheetBeforeDelete(ByVal Sh As Object)
    ' This runs before a sheet is deleted
    Dim response As VbMsgBoxResult
    response = MsgBox("Are you sure you want to delete sheet: " & Sh.Name & "?", vbYesNo + vbQuestion)
    If response = vbNo Then
        ' Note: Cannot cancel sheet deletion in this event
    End If
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_WindowActivate(ByVal Wn As Window)
    ' This runs when a workbook window is activated
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_WindowDeactivate(ByVal Wn As Window)
    ' This runs when a workbook window is deactivated
End Sub

Private Sub Workbook_WindowResize(ByVal Wn As Window)
    ' This runs when a workbook window is resized
End Sub

================================================================================
INSTRUCTIONS FOR ADDING VBA CODE:
================================================================================

1. STANDARD MODULES (Module1 through Module10):
   - In VBA Editor, right-click in Project Explorer (left panel)
   - Select Insert > Module
   - Name the module (Module1, Module2, etc.) in Properties window
   - Paste the code for that module

2. SHEET-SPECIFIC CODE:
   - In Project Explorer, find the sheet name (e.g., "Data", "Calculations")
   - Double-click the sheet name OR right-click > View Code
   - Paste the appropriate code for that sheet

3. WORKBOOK CODE (ThisWorkbook):
   - In Project Explorer, find "ThisWorkbook"
   - Double-click "ThisWorkbook"
   - Paste the workbook event code

4. SAVE THE WORKBOOK:
   - Press Ctrl+S (or Cmd+S on Mac)
   - Or File > Save
   - The workbook must be saved as .xlsm or .xlsb to retain VBA code

5. TESTING:
   - Press F5 in VBA Editor to run a procedure
   - Or create a button on a sheet and assign a macro
   - Or call functions from worksheet cells (e.g., =AddNumbers(5, 3))

================================================================================
TOTAL VBA CODE SUMMARY:
================================================================================

- 10 Standard Modules (Module1 through Module10)
- 4 Sheet-specific code modules (Data, Calculations, Complex, ChartData)
- 1 Workbook code module (ThisWorkbook with 15+ event handlers)
- Over 100 functions and procedures
- Comprehensive error handling examples
- File operations, string manipulation, date/time functions
- Financial calculations, statistical analysis
- Range and cell operations
- Array processing
- And much more!

This provides extensive VBA code coverage for testing the xl2jupyter converter.
